reviewScope: Stories 4 and 5 for all 197 roster countries. The v23 first three stories and ten keywords are preserved exactly. This is not a new independent audit of every retained fact, capital role or coordinate.
method: Original bilingual child-oriented passages. Listed primary references support named places, objects, historical context and natural features. Scientific comparisons, diagram exercises, counting and observation questions are authored teaching extensions, not statements copied from those references. Country/capital comparisons reuse the app roster and its existing evidence. Tentative properties, biosphere reserves and geoparks are distinguished from inscribed World Heritage properties. Unresolved explanations remain questions or qualified hypotheses.
